hero.title: You've read the label a hundred times.
hero.subtitle: You still don't know what's in it.

stat_72_percent.headline: uncertain
stat_72_percent.body: In our first analysis of real supermarket products, 72% of results were uncertain — not because the ingredients were forbidden, but because the label simply didn't say enough to know.
stat_72_percent.conclusion: This isn't a Halal problem, or a sugar problem, or a women's health problem. It's a transparency problem. And it affects everyone.

evidence_based.label: Evidence-based modules
evidence_based.description: Based on scientific and regulatory evidence from WHO, EFSA, FDA, Codex Alimentarius and other official sources.

choice_based.label: Choice-based modules
choice_based.description: Support personal, ethical, religious, or dietary decisions. They do not tell people what to eat. They explain what the label makes visible — and what it does not.

woman_not_life_stage.title: Woman is not a life stage
woman_not_life_stage.body: Woman is a scientific evidence layer. It does not mean pregnancy. It does not reduce women's health to reproduction. It highlights evidence relevant to women's biology when that evidence exists, and leaves it out when it does not.

steps.title: Scan
steps.description: BOTIA reads the ingredient list from the label.

steps.title: Detect
steps.description: BOTIA identifies relevant signals organised into clear layers.

steps.title: Understand
steps.description: Each icon opens a simple explanation based on official evidence.

transparency_first.title: Transparency first
transparency_first.body: BOTIA only informs based on the ingredients read from the label. It does not analyse the whole product. It does not certify food. It does not replace medical, religious, legal, or professional advice. It does not see what the label does not declare.
transparency_first.highlight: When BOTIA shows uncertainty, that uncertainty is part of the information.

closing.claim: Most apps tell you what to buy. BOTIA tells you what you're actually buying.
closing.tagline: You finally see what you're eating.

privacy.title: Privacy by design
privacy.body: BOTIA analyses food labels, not people. It does not build personal food profiles or store your scans. Your Google account manages authentication. BOTIA only keeps the information strictly necessary to operate the service.
